results.title: Konongo traffic gridlock: Motorists lose hours as authorities promise relief in 3 weeks
results.content: Motorists and commuters travelling along the Konongo-Kumasi-Accra highway are spending more than two hours navigating severe traffic congestion, with authorities promising relief within three weeks.

results.title: Timothy Bentum announces five-year anti-drug tour targeting 252 SHSs across Ghana
results.content: Media personality and Lead Pastor of Grace Avenue Ministry, Timothy Bentum, has announced a five-year anti-drug abuse campaign targeting 252 senior high schools across Ghana's 16 regions to educate students on substance abuse, peer pressure and the dangers of addiction.

results.title: Timothy Bentum urges parents to be actively involved in children’s lives to prevent drug abuse
results.content: Media personality and Lead Pastor of Grace Avenue Ministry, Timothy Bentum, has urged parents to become more actively involved in their children's lives beyond providing financial support, warning that peer pressure and drug abuse continue to threaten the future of young people.

results.title: “Invest in Ghana, produce here and grow” – Ato Forson Urges Investors
results.content: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has called on local and international investors to commit resources to businesses in Ghana, stressing the need to translate investment opportunities into actual projects that will expand production and create jobs.

results.title: Ghanaian rice quality has improved significantly – CSIR-CRI Chief Director
results.content: The Chief Research Scientist and Director at the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research–Crops Research Institute (CSIR-CRI), Professor Maxwell Darko Asante, says the quality of locally produced rice has improved significantly, dismissing concerns that poor processing is responsible for its low patronage.

results.title: Don Little accuses female police officer of verbal abuse during encounter in Kumasi
results.content: Ghanaian actor Don Little has expressed anger and disappointment towards the Ghana Police Service following an alleged unpleasant encounter with a female police officer at Kumasi Breman.

results.title: Ghanaian farmers losing confidence in rice farming – CSIR-CRI Chief Scientist
results.content: The Chief Research Scientist and Director at the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research–Crops Research Institute (CSIR-CRI), Professor Maxwell Darko Asante, says Ghanaian farmers are losing confidence in rice farming due to difficulties in selling their produce.

results.title: Otumfuo pushes for creative industry investment to boost Ghana’s economy
results.content: The Asantehene, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II, has called for increased investment in Ghana’s creative industry, identifying its potential to generate employment, create wealth and drive economic growth.

results.title: When budgets are used for propaganda and not planning – The Interesting case of Democratic Ghana
results.content: In the simplest terms, a budget is a financial plan for a set period (like a month or year) that tracks expected income versus expenses, helping individuals, businesses, or governments manage money, set priorities, and achieve financial goals by ensuring spending aligns with resources, preventing debt, and allocating funds for savings or specific purposes. It acts as a roadmap for your money, showing where it comes from (income) and where it goes (expenses). This is an Investopedia definition, but it will suffice for the purposes of this citizen discourse For the life of any business or government that runs well, budgets are tools used for planning. They give the business an opportunity to conceive ideas and devise strategies based on a certain future prediction or expectation. results.title: INTERPOL RULING: OSP failed to update “minimal” facts on Ofori-Atta’s Red Notice despite filing 78 charges
results.content: Even after the Office of the Special Prosecutor filed 78 criminal charges against former Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta and seven others in the SML, the INTERPOL Red Notice issued against Mr Ofori-Atta was still based on an older warrant with “minimal factual information” that listed only one offence.
